newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Leisure to sell group firm stake.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Leisure to sell group firm stake.

text.p: Berjaya Leisure Bhd said it was selling its entire stake in Berjaya Sports Toto Bhd to its existing shareholders at 3.5 ringgit each as part of a restructuring exercise.
Berjaya Leisure shareholders will be entitled to one Sports Toto share for every two shares held, the company said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) late on Friday.
Berjaya Leisure said it will raise 1.55 billion ringgit from the sale, which will be used to mainly repay borrowings.

"Berjaya Leisure will be transformed into a property conglomerate with interests in property development, investments, hotels, resorts and leisure-related operations" after the completion of the share sale, the statement said.
Berjaya Leisure also announced plans to change its name to Berjaya Land Bhd and has asked the KLSE to reclassify it under the property group.
Group parent, Berjaya Group Bhd, said it will fund its entitlement of 1.17 billion ringgit through internal funds and short-term borrowings.
